name: Tourmaline
description: A gemstone of remarkable variety, tourmaline ranges from soft blush pink and vibrant red to forest green and ocean blue. Each stone has its own personality, making it a beautiful starting point for a piece designed around you.

name: Amethyst
description: Amethyst is admired for its spectrum of violet tones, from pale lilac to deep purple. Its distinctive colour creates an expressive yet timeless focal point.

name: Lemon Quartz
description: Lemon quartz has a fresh, citrus-yellow glow that feels both bright and refined. It brings a light, contemporary energy to jewellery.

name: Citrine
description: Known for its luminous golden hues, citrine brings warmth and effortless brightness to fine jewellery. Its sunny colour lends itself to elegant, individual designs.

name: Black Rutile
description: Black rutilated quartz is distinguished by dark, needle-like inclusions within the stone. Its natural patterns create a dramatic, individual look.

name: Yellow Sapphire
description: Yellow sapphire is prized for its luminous yellow colour, from soft golden tones to vivid sunshine shades. Its brilliance brings warmth to a distinctive piece.

name: Peridot
description: Peridot stands out with its fresh green colour and lively luminosity. Its distinctive hue creates a modern, optimistic expression.

name: Topaz
description: Topaz is a versatile gemstone found in an array of shades. Its clarity and brilliance make it an appealing choice for a carefully considered bespoke creation.

name: Rose Quartz
description: Rose quartz is admired for its delicate pink hue and gentle, translucent appearance. It is a subtle and personal choice for jewellery.

name: Fluorite
description: Fluorite is appreciated for its beautiful colour zoning and subtle transitions of tone. Its natural variation gives each stone a distinctive appearance.

name: Green Amethyst
description: Green amethyst, commonly known in jewellery as prasiolite, is loved for its gentle sage-green appearance. It offers a calm, understated aesthetic.

name: Garnet
description: Garnet offers rich, expressive colour, often associated with deep red but found in a broader palette. It brings depth and character to a personal design.

name: London Blue Topaz
description: London blue topaz is celebrated for its deep, sophisticated blue tone. Its rich colour makes a striking centrepiece for a distinctive design.

name: Morganite
description: With its delicate blush and peach tones, morganite is prized for its understated, romantic character. Its soft glow pairs beautifully with refined, personal jewellery.

name: Smoky Quartz
description: Smoky quartz is recognised for its translucent taupe and earthy brown tones. Its restrained elegance suits contemporary, understated jewellery.

name: Emerald
description: Emerald is cherished for its vivid green colour and enduring appeal. Its natural inclusions can give each stone a character that is entirely its own.

name: Blue Sapphire
description: Blue sapphire is known for its elegant blue hues, from soft cornflower to rich midnight tones. It offers a timeless and confident expression.
